title: The First Sword of Counterattack
next_chapter_hook: The moment Chen Ji and the Demonic Path Commander clapped hands in oath, in the depths of the Chen family's ancestral land in the mortal realm, a seal that had been dormant for many years suddenly burst forth with dazzling golden light—that was a 'Heavenly Fate Resonance' that only the Chen bloodline could trigger. The wheel of destiny has already begun to turn.

text.content: Mist churned like tides beneath Chen Ji's feet, yet it could not conceal the cold gleam in his eyes. Under the Heaven's Eye, Cang Yutian's insufferable face appeared ridiculously laughable—eternal undying legend? Hmph, nothing more than a body rotting from within. What he saw were not only cracks, but the frantically struggling fragments of fate within those cracks, each screaming, wailing, trying to escape their host. Chen Ji slowly withdrew the Heaven's Eye, a playful arc forming at the corner of his lips. Spending five Heavenly Fate points to see a dying man's countdown—quite a worthwhile deal.

dialogue.content: "What, Chen family remnant, lost your tongue at my divine might?" Cang Yutian's voice came from all directions, carrying overwhelming arrogance. "I'll give you a chance. Kneel, submit, and I shall preserve a place for you in the apocalyptic flood." His golden phantom swelled again, obscuring half the sky, oppressive might pressing down like mountains collapsing. The surrounding Demonic Path cultivators all changed expressions; those with lower cultivation even began trembling. "Is this the foundation of the Heavenly Eye..." someone murmured, voice full of fear.

Yet Chen Ji laughed. Not a cold laugh, not a bitter laugh, but a genuine laugh with a sense of exhilaration. He stood with hands clasped behind his back, letting the oppressive might surge like tidewater, yet he didn't even furrow his brow. "Senior Cang Yutian," his voice wasn't loud but clearly penetrated the pervasive demonic qi and oppressive might, "you just said you'd give me a chance?" He slightly tilted his head up,直视 that golden phantom suspended like a scorching sun in the sky, a flash of mockery flickering in his eyes. "Then I'd like to ask—when did those cracks in the depths of your eyes begin? Three months ago? Half a year ago? Or... even earlier?"

text.content: The words fell, and something in heaven and earth seemed to suddenly freeze. Cang Yutian's golden phantom trembled violently, and in those eyes凝聚 by heavenly will, a trace of disbelief flickered. He could sense the information within Chen Ji's words—this ant-like junior actually saw through his collapsing state! "What did you say?" Cang Yutian's voice lost its earlier composure, carrying sharp questioning. "What nonsense are you spouting!" Chen Ji paid no attention to his bluster, slowly raising his right hand with three fingers extended. "Three hours." he said calmly. "I'll give you three hours. After three hours, those fragments of fate within you will break free from your control. At that time, without anyone lifting a finger, you'll explode from within yourself." He withdrew his fingers, smiling faintly. "So, are you sure you're giving me a chance, rather than me giving you time?"

dialogue.content: "Ridiculous!" Cang Yutian's roar shook mountains and earth. "A mere Jindan-stage ant dares speak of my life and death?!" The golden phantom swelled violently, transforming into a palm huge enough to block the heavens, slamming down toward Chen Ji. Before the palm wind even arrived, the peaks below had begun cracking, rocks turning to dust. However, at this critical moment, a black figure suddenly appeared before Chen Ji, swiping one hand toward the sky, completely blocking that golden giant palm. "Cang Yutian, you're too impatient." The newcomer's voice was low and hoarse, yet carried undeniable oppressive might. "I was still negotiating business with Young Friend Chen, and you want to crush him to death?" The Demonic Path Commander had finally revealed himself.

text.content: Chen Ji gazed at the tall figure before him, a flicker of calculation passing through his eyes. Perfect timing. The reason he dared openly expose Cang Yutian's weakness, apart from what the Heaven's Eye revealed, was the Demonic Path Commander's presence. This existence that had been entangled with the Heavenly Eye for who knows how many millennia probably understood Cang Yutian better than anyone. The enemy of my enemy is my friend—at least until we kill our common enemy. "Commander Senior," Chen Ji looked past the Demonic Path Commander's shoulder, directly at Cang Yutian's violently trembling golden eyes, "you asked earlier what I want. Now, I can answer you." He took a deep breath, voice turning cold and firm. "I want—to personally shatter this ancient chess game."

choice.prompt: Chen Ji presented his conditions, now it was time to decide the cooperation method

choices.description: While Cang Yutian has not yet fully unsealed, launch a sudden attack to catch him off guard
choices.visible_cost: Extremely high risk, may alert the enemy
choices.visible_reward: Seize the initiative, if successful can directly weaken the Heavenly Eye's power foundation
choices.risk_hint: Although Cang Yutian is declining, his ten-thousand-year accumulation should not be underestimated

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze was sharp as a blade. "Senior, Cang Yutian is now strong in appearance but weak within—this is precisely the best opportunity. If we wait for him to stabilize his foundation before acting, it will be ten times harder." His voice carried undeniable resolve. "The junior is willing to serve as the vanguard, scouting the path for the Senior."

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path Commander fell silent for a moment, then suddenly burst into laughter. "Excellent! I've waited ten thousand years, finally encountering a lad daring to draw a sword against heaven!" He turned, meeting Chen Ji's gaze, dangerous light flickering in his eyes. "Chen whelp, I'll remember you."

choices.description: First gather intelligence, identify Cang Yutian's weaknesses, formulate thorough plans before acting
choices.visible_cost: Time is tight, may miss opportunities
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian is at the edge of collapse, growing stronger with each passing moment

text.content: Chen Ji shook his head, his expression terrifyingly calm. "Cang Yutian has held heaven's will for ten thousand years after all—who knows how many hidden cards he still hasn't revealed?" His voice was low and rational. "My suggestion is—first plan, then act."

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path Commander nodded slightly, the playfulness in his eyes gradually turning serious. "Continue."

choices.description: Deep cooperation with the Demonic Path Commander, share information and support each other, while maintaining independent will
choices.visible_cost: Need to expose some trump cards, may be spied upon by allies
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Demonic Path Commander's ten-thousand-year intelligence support, greatly increase victory odds
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path Commander may not be trustworthy, must leave backup plans

text.content: Chen Ji met the Demonic Path Commander's scrutinizing gaze, smiling candidly. "Senior has tangled with Cang Yutian for ten thousand years, understanding him best. The junior is willing to use the Heaven's Eye as a medium, sharing intelligence and discussing grand strategies with the Senior." His tone was sincere yet unyielding. "But there's one point—I need to retain the power to act independently."

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path Commander's eyes narrowed; after a long moment, he suddenly burst into laughter. "Independent action—good one!" He patted Chen Ji's shoulder. "I love cooperating with smart people. Rest assured, I won't interfere with your judgment, but if there's a critical moment—" His smile turned meaningful. "I hope you won't mind my intervention either."

text.content: Three choices were laid upon the scales of fate. Chen Ji did not urge, merely waiting quietly. He was gambling—gambling the Demonic Path Commander could see his value, gambling this existence bearing blood feud with the Heavenly Eye wouldn't easily abandon an ally who could see Cang Yutian's weaknesses. Mist churned between them, Cang Yutian's golden phantom trembled violently in the distance, seemingly hesitating whether to continue attacking or temporarily retreat. And the Demonic Path Commander's gaze lingered on Chen Ji for a very, very long time. "Interesting," he finally spoke, genuine appreciation in his voice, "Chen whelp, do you know how many years I've faced Cang Yutian?"

dialogue.content: "Thirty-seven thousand years." The Demonic Path Commander provided his own answer, voice carrying inexpressible complex emotions. "For thirty-seven thousand years, I've watched him devour heaven's way step by step, transform the entire world into his chessboard piece by piece. I thought this game had reached its end." He suddenly turned, facing Chen Ji's eyes directly. "Until today, when I saw you. A mere Jindan-stage junior, actually daring to openly expose his weakness." A slow smile spread across the Demonic Path Commander's lips. "What's more interesting is—what you said was true." He waved one hand, and a black jade slip appeared in his palm, emanating ancient and profound气息. "This contains all the intelligence I've gathered over thirty-seven thousand years. Regarding Cang Yutian, regarding the Heavenly Eye, regarding those secrets he thought he hid perfectly." He extended the jade slip toward Chen Ji. "Now, they're all yours."

text.content: Chen Ji accepted the jade slip, his spiritual sense probing within. In an instant, information vast as an ocean flooded his mind like a deluge—Cang Yutian's cultivation journey, the collection methods of fate fragments, the sealing formation structure of the Heavenly Core, even detailed records of thousands of battles large and small. Yet what shocked Chen Ji most was another piece of information. "The reason he began to collapse," Chen Ji slowly raised his head, eyes gleaming with brilliance, "is because of something he did eight thousand years ago—extracting Heavenly Fate origin, forcibly catalyzing the fate fragments." He looked at the Demonic Path Commander, voice becoming razor-sharp. "Where did he extract that Heavenly Fate origin from?" The Demonic Path Commander's smile turned ice-cold. "Good question." He pointed toward Cang Yutian's collapsing golden phantom in the distance. "Have you ever wondered why, during every Heavenly Fate Catastrophe, those wealthy and powerful great families always suffered the worst?" Chen Ji's heart clenched violently. "The Chen family... the Chen family extermination case eight thousand years ago..."

"Correct." The Demonic Path Commander's voice was like cold ice. "Eight thousand years ago, Cang Yutian used the Heavenly Fate Catastrophe as cover, extracting all the qi fortune of the world's foremost family, the Chen family—along with the Heavenly Fate origins of those innocently slaughtered, refining them into nourishment for the fate fragments." "He thought he'd done it perfectly, unaware that I've been observing from the shadows." The Demonic Path Commander's smile carried a hint of mockery. "The joke is, the Chen bloodline wasn't severed. The hidden child later gave birth to another child, that child gave birth to..." He looked meaningfully at Chen Ji. "You." Chen Ji fell silent. So that's how it was. So the Chen family's destruction was never some heavenly cycle, but the Heavenly Will's own handiwork. So his grudge with Cang Yutian was sealed eight thousand years ago. So—he was the variable. "Interesting," Chen Ji suddenly laughed, his laughter carrying both satisfaction and a hint of madness. "This truly is... fate's cruel sense of humor."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji put away the jade slip, his gaze becoming unprecedentedly sharp. "Since that's the case," his voice was cold as a blade, "our objective becomes very clear." He raised his hand, pointing toward Cang Yutian struggling in the distance. "Cang Yutian's method of collecting fate fragments is through Heavenly Fate Catastrophes to harvest families with deep qi fortune. The reason he's now beginning to collapse is because those fate fragments are unstable—before being fully refined, they retain the original owner's will remnants." He turned to the Demonic Path Commander, eyes blazing. "So our tactics aren't direct confrontation, but—destroying his harvesting process." The Demonic Path Commander's eyes lit up. "Continue." "There's a sealing formation at his Heavenly Core," Chen Ji said slowly and precisely, "as long as we destroy that formation before the fate fragments are fully refined, the fragments will go out of control—at that time, without us lifting a finger, he'll be devoured by his own backlash." He extended his palm. "Commander Senior, what do you think?"

choice.prompt: Strategy set, how should we proceed?

choices.visible_reward: By surprise attack, one fatal strike

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze was like a hawk's. "Speed is paramount in war. Cang Yutian is now preoccupied—precisely the best moment—not a moment to waste." His voice was iron-clad. "The junior is willing to serve as the vanguard."

dialogue.content: A flash of approval crossed the Demonic Path Commander's eyes. "Brave spirit! I'll open the Heavenly Passage now—remember, only success, no failure!"

choices.description: First reorganize the Demonic Army, advance steadily and surely, ensure foolproof success
choices.visible_reward: Be fully prepared, fight at ease

text.content: Chen Ji shook his head, calm light flickering in his eyes. "Haste makes waste. Cang Yutian after all holds heaven's will for ten thousand years—our rash attack will only alert the enemy." He pondered. "Give me three days. I need to cross-reference your intelligence with the Tianji Record's foresight, to formulate the most perfect plan."

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path Commander pondered for a moment, then slowly nodded. "Very well, I've waited thirty-seven thousand years—what's three more days?" He gazed at Chen Ji, adding a new layer of scrutiny. "In three days, I want to see a complete battle plan."

choices.description: Split forces into two—Chen Ji uses Heaven's Eye to pin down Cang Yutian while the Demonic Path Commander leads the main force to seize the Heavenly Core
choices.visible_cost: Chen Ji must face the Heavenly Eye's pressure alone
choices.visible_reward: Two-front warfare, leaving Cang Yutian stretched thin

text.content: A flash of determination crossed Chen Ji's eyes. "I'll pin down Cang Yutian." His voice was calm yet firm. "His current fate is all due to the Chen bloodline—this debt, I'll settle personally."

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path Commander gazed deeply at Chen Ji, the scrutiny in his eyes finally transforming into genuine respect. "Excellent!" He nodded heavily. "Chen whelp, I'll remember you—if you survive, I'll owe you one!"

text.content: Two choices, two directions. Chen Ji stood in place, his gaze sweeping across the black jade slip containing ten-thousand-year intelligence, then toward that frantically struggling golden phantom in the distance. Cang Yutian was no longer that high-and-mighty Heavenly Will. He was a wounded beast, a dying man on countdown, a—chess master abandoned by fate. And he, Chen Ji, would personally end this ancient chess game. "Commander Senior," he suddenly spoke, voice carrying undeniable resolve, "regardless of which method we choose, one thing must be clear." He turned, facing the Demonic Path Commander's eyes directly. "From today onward, we are merely cooperating, not in a master-servant relationship. You may choose to adopt or reject my strategies; but please respect my judgments." "Because—" a cold smile curled at the corner of his lips, "I understand this game's rules better than anyone."

The words fell, and Chen Ji extended his palm, five fingers spread wide. The Demonic Path Commander looked at him, then suddenly smiled. That smile held admiration, amusement, and a trace of long-missing anticipation. "Very well." He raised his hand, and his palm struck Chen Ji's in midair, producing a clear sound. "One word, unchangeable." This strike was the beginning of cooperation. This strike was the declaration of counterattack. This strike was the first sword of the ancient chess game being shattered— And the one wielding the sword was precisely that whomever everyone once mocked as waste, Chen Ji. In the distance, Cang Yutian's golden phantom let out furious roars, yet could no longer stop any of this. Because he finally realized that the ant he never looked twice at had grown into a giant tree capable of shaking the heavens. "Chen Ji—!" Cang Yutian's roar shook heaven and earth. "I shall make you pay the price!" Chen Ji raised his head, toward that collapsing golden sun, offering a faint smile. "Senior, you have no time left."

However, just as Chen Ji prepared to discuss details further with the Demonic Path Commander, his brow center suddenly twitched. The Tianji Record Fragment trembled violently in his Mental Sea, emitting a string of urgent warnings. Chen Ji's expression abruptly changed—that was the direction of the Chen family's ancestral land in the mortal realm, that was his bloodline's root, that was— "The seal at the Chen family's ancestral land has been triggered." His voice turned ice-cold, hands unconsciously clenching into fists. That seal was the Chen family's final line of defense existing since his birth. What it contained was the 'Heavenly Fate Resonance Array' left by the Chen ancestors—an ultimate guardian only triggerable by Chen bloodline. And now, it had been activated. What did this mean? Were there still Chen descendants? Or was someone trying to covet the Chen family's legacy? Chen Ji's gaze instantly turned dangerous. Whoever it was, he would not let them go. "Commander Senior," he turned to the Demonic Path Commander, voice carrying suppressed fury, "It seems our plans need to change slightly."

At the same moment Chen Ji sensed the mortal realm's disturbance, billions of miles away in the mortal realm, deep within the ruins of the Chen family's ancestral land, a sealing formation dormant for ten thousand years suddenly blazed with dazzling golden light. That golden light shot skyward, piercing through layers of clouds, and even existences far in the Heavenly Realm could clearly feel that familiar yet strange aura— That was the aura of the Chen bloodline. That was the aura of Heavenly Fate origin. That was... the call of destiny. Beneath the ruins, an eye sealed for who knows how many ages slowly opened. Those eyes held confusion, rage, and an unbelievable joy. "The Chen bloodline... not yet extinguished..." An old and weak voice sounded in the darkness, trembling slightly. "Master, this old servant has finally waited..."
